next_step_summary: PR #245 implements the first populated provider-independent Question Engine inventory on the existing immutable schema foundation. The bounded slice adds one monthly-rent baseline plus recurring pre-signing security questions covering distinct instruments, cumulative/alternative relationships, amounts, blank instrument fields, named payees/transfer restrictions, completion authority, linkage to obligations/periods/separate documents, realization grounds/amount/notice/cure, recovery overlap, option continuity, return mechanics, and guarantor scope. It adds no conditional trigger runtime, evidence-target layer, statutory/case-law runtime, LLM/provider integration, UI, OCR, Android, serverless, storage, dependencies, permissions, or network access. The next bounded inventory slice is early exit + replacement tenant.
